'''''Advances in Group Theory and Applications''''' (AGTA) is a [[peer review]]ed, [[open access]] [[research journal]] in [[mathematics]], specifically [[group theory]]. It was founded in 2015 by the council of the no-profit association [[AGTA - Advances in Group Theory and Applications]], and is published by [[Aracne]].

The journal is composed of three sections. The main one contains mathematical research papers, while the two other sections are respectively devoted to historical papers and open problems.

The journal is published as a [[diamond open access journal]], meaning that the content is immediately freely available to the readers, and the authors do not have to pay any author publication fees.<ref>[http://www.advgrouptheory.com/journal/#aims Aims and Scope], ''Advances in Group Theory and Applications'', [[Aracne]]</ref>

The journal is [[abstracting and indexing|abstracted and indexed]] by ''[[Mathematical Reviews]]<ref>https://www.ams.org/dmr/JournalList.html "List of journals indexed by the [[American Mathematical Society]]".</ref>'' and ''[[Zentralblatt MATH]]''.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://zbmath.org/journals/?q=se:00008849 | title=Advances in Group Theory and Applications - Serial Profile - zbMATH Open }}</ref>

==Sections==
===A<sub>D</sub>V – The History behind Group Theory===

The purpose of this section is to present historical documents, biographical notes and discussions on relevant aspects of group theory and its applications.

===A<sub>D</sub>V – Perspectives in Group Theory===

The open problems submitted to the journal are published in this section.

==Reinhold Baer Prize sponsorship==
The journal started co-sponsoring the [[Aracne#Reinhold Baer Prize|Reinhold Baer Prize]] in 2017.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.advgrouptheory.com/BaerPrize/BaerPrize2017.html | title=Baer Prize }}</ref>

==Proceedings==
Volume 15 publishes the proceedings of the conference Groups & Algebras in Bicocca 
for Young algebraists 2022.<ref>https://staff.matapp.unimib.it/~/gaby/gaby2022/index.html "GABY 2022".</ref><ref>https://www.advgrouptheory.com/journal/index.php#vol15 "Volume 15"</ref>
